name: CSXA, the Cervical Spine X-ray Atlas V3.0 (Ran et al., Scientific Data 2024)
what: 4,963 lateral cervical radiographs with vertebral corner points in JSON
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/csxa_cervical_xray_atlas, downloaded from Science Data Bank and the release's GitHub repository, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-09; nothing to fetch.
